comment: Recorded decisions for informational advisories, the ones cargo audit
reports as unsound, yanked, unmaintained or notice. A vulnerability
advisory never appears here: those block unconditionally and cargo audit
Empty on 2026-10-03, because anyhow 1.0.104 and spin 0.9.9 cleared the two
that were open. advisory-check.py proves its own parser on fixtures rather
than on this file, since an empty file and a broken parser look the same.
An entry carries parameters, never a command. See advisory-check.py for the
typed checks and what each one establishes.
